honest_limits: Read-only. Reporting that an install is possible is NOT the same claim as having done one.
MIN_FREE_GB is ASSERTED from stage A's own 'the per-site table is ~3M rows' comment, not measured against a completed sweep.

A SATISFIABLE verdict bounds only whether an isolated environment could be CREATED here. It says nothing about whether the regenerated pipeline would reproduce the frozen bar's committed per-seed anchors, which is a separate and stricter question.
Module-level import extraction is textual (column-0 regex), not an AST parse; a dynamic import would not appear.
